title: The Subconscious Brain
subtitle: How the words you repeat to yourself become the body you live in.
subtitleZh: 你反复对自己说的话，如何变成你身体里的现实。
author: @alexeixbt
description: A short viral thread on self-talk, repetition, and the claim that the subconscious mind cannot tell imagination from reality.
descriptionZh: 一则关于自我暗示与重复的短文，主张潜意识无法分辨想象与现实。

paragraphs.en: you will never see your brain the same after reading this:
paragraphs.zh: 读完这篇文章后，你将永远不会看到你的大脑是一样的：

paragraphs.en: if you tell yourself "i am sick," you will eventually become sick. this is the power of your subconscious mind. your subconscious mind doesn't care about truth. it follows repetition. it can't tell the difference between imagination and reality. it just listens and obeys.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你告诉自己“我病了”，你最终会生病。这就是你潜意识的力量。你的潜意识并不关心真相。它遵循重复。它无法区分想象和现实。它只是倾听并服从。

paragraphs.en: every time you say "i am unlucky," "i am tired," "i am not enough," you're literally casting a biological spell. your brain wires it in, and your body literally becomes the memory of those words.
paragraphs.zh: 每当你说“我很不幸”、“我很累”、“我还不够”时，你实际上是在施展生物咒语。你的大脑将其连接起来，你的身体就真正成为了这些单词的记忆。

paragraphs.en: but the opposite is also true. if you tell yourself "i am healthy," your body starts to heal. if you tell yourself "i am confident," your posture, your tone, your chemistry begin to change. and if you tell yourself "i am rich," your subconscious starts hunting for ways to make it true.
paragraphs.zh: 但反之亦然。如果你告诉自己“我很健康”，你的身体就会开始痊愈。如果你告诉自己“我有信心”，你的姿势、你的语气、你的化学反应就会开始改变。如果你告诉自己“我很富有”，你的潜意识就会开始寻找实现它的方法。

paragraphs.en: so speak wisely, because your body is always listening.
paragraphs.zh: 所以明智地说话，因为你的身体一直在倾听。
